suggested_change: Criterion 2: Replace exact-phrase matching ('No new information in this call — maintaining previous score of X/10') with outcome-focused language ('Score unchanged from prior call because [reason]'). Criterion 4: Replace 'concrete timing + contact + action verb' requirement with 'next step must specify: (a) who, (b) what question/objective, (c) dependency or constraint' without mandating call cadence format. Criterion 3: Add 'Explicit ICP fit statement required—confirm fit OR flag concern with reason' as separate sub-criterion rather than embedded evaluation.
